item.title: 'Sick and pathetic': Analysts outraged by Republicans' latest attack on trans people
item.description: The latest attack against the transgender community by Republicans in Kansas incited outrage among analysts on Wednesday night. The Kansas Division of Vehicles sent letters to transgender people on Wednesday, saying that their driver's licenses would be considered invalid as of Thursday because of a new state law, Erin In The Morning reported. That law also said transgender people caught driving with an invalid license can be charged with a class B misdemeanor, carrying up to six months in jail
